problems.rationale: The string has up to 300,000 colors. The reference advances two pointers inward over matching outer runs, checks merged-run lengths for elimination, and counts insertion positions in the central run.
Rational players vote based on survival and payoff. The voting game reduces to ceil(N/2), which the reference computes directly for N up to one billion.
Each length-two path is determined by its middle vertex and an unordered pair of neighbors. The reference counts these pairs while reading edges, equivalent to summing degree(v) choose 2.
